verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              पाण्डवैः सह संयोगं गतस्य द्रुपदस्य ह। न बभूव भयं किंचिद्देवेभ्योऽपि कथंचन॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : After his alliance with the Pandavas, Drupada had all his fears dispelled; and he did not fear even the celestials.

verses.sanskrit: कुन्तीमासाद्य ता नार्यो द्रुपदस्य महात्मनः। नाम संकीर्तयन्त्योऽस्या जग्मुः पादौ स्वमूर्धभिः॥२॥
verses.english: The ladies of the illustrious Draupada's (household) all came to Kunti; and mentioning their respective names, they saluted her with their heads touching the ground.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णा च क्षौमसंवीता कृतकौतुकमङ्गला। कृताभिवादना श्वश्र्वा तस्थौ प्रह्वा कृताञ्जलिः॥३॥
verses.english: Krishna, attired in red silk and with her wrists still encircled with auspicious thread, saluted her mother-in-law with reverence; and she then stood before her contentedly with joined hands.
Out of affection Pritha (Kunti) pronounced a blessing on Draupadi, endued with beauty and auspicious marks and with sweet disposition and good character.

verses.sanskrit: यथेन्द्राणी हरिहये स्वाहा चैव विभावसौ। रोहिणी च यथा सोमे दमयन्ती यथा नले॥५॥
verses.english: Kunti said : As Sachi is to Indra, as Svaha to Vibhavasu, as Rohini to Soma, as Damayanti to Nala.

verses.sanskrit: यथा वैश्रवणे भद्रा वसिष्ठे चाप्यरुन्धती। यथा नारायणे लक्ष्मीस्तथा त्वं भव भर्तृषु॥६॥
verses.english: As Bhadra to Vaishravana, as Arundhati to Vasishtha and as Lakshmi to Narayana, so be you to your husbands.

verses.sanskrit: जीवसूर्वीरसूर्भद्रे बहुसौख्यसमन्विता। सुभगा भोगसंपन्ना यज्ञपत्नी पतिव्रता॥७॥
verses.english: Oamiable girl, be the mother of long-lived and heroic children and possess every thing that can make you happy. Be lucky and prosperous, be faithful to your husbands and a performer of great sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: अतिथीनागतान्साधून्वृद्दान्बालांस्तथा गुरून्। पूजयन्त्या यथान्यायं शश्वद्गच्छन्तु ते समाः॥८॥
verses.english: Let your time be ever passed in duly entertaining your guests, the strangers that come to your house, the pious men, the old men, the children and the superiors.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुजाङ्गलमुख्येषु राष्ट्रेषु नगरेषु च। अनु त्वमभिषिच्यस्व नृपतिं धर्मवत्सला॥९॥
verses.english: Be installed with the virtue-loving king (Yudhishthira) as the queen of the kingdom and the capital of Kurujangala.

verses.sanskrit: पतिभिर्निर्जितामुर्वीं विक्रमेण महाबलैः। कुरु ब्राह्मणसात्सर्वामश्वमेधे महाक्रतौ॥१०॥
verses.english: Let the whole earth, conquered by your greatly powerful husbands, be given to the Brahmanas in a great Ashvamedha sacrifice.
verses.bhavadeepa: अभिषिच्यस्व अभिषेकं प्राप्नुहि । नृपतिं पट्टाभिषिक्तं राजानमनु ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां यानि रत्नानि गुणवन्ति गुणान्विते। तान्याप्नुहि त्वं कल्याणि सुखिनी शरदां शतम्॥११॥
verses.english: O accomplished girl, what gems of great qualities are in the world, let them all belong to you. O blessed girl, be happy for (full) one hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: यथा च त्वाभिनन्दामि वध्वद्य क्षौमसंवृताम्। तथा भूयोऽभिनन्दिष्ये जातपुत्रां गुणान्विताम्॥१२॥
verses.english: O daughter-in-law, as I rejoice to-day on seeing you in red silk, so I shall rejoice when you will give birth to an accomplished son.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              ततस्तु कृतदारेभ्यः पाण्डुभ्यः प्राहिणोद्धरिः। वैदूर्यमणिचित्राणि हैमान्याभरणानि च॥१३॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : After the Pandavas had been married, Hari (Krishna) sent them various golden ornaments set with pearls and Vaidurya gems.

verses.sanskrit: वासांसि च महार्हाणि नानादेश्यानि माधवः। कम्बलाजिनरत्नानि स्पर्शवन्ति शुभानि च॥१४॥
verses.english: Madhava (Krishna) also sent (to them) costly robes of various countries, many beautiful and soft blankets and skins,

verses.sanskrit: शयनासनयानानि विविधानि महान्ति च। वैदूर्यवज्रचित्राणि शतशो भाजनानि च॥१५॥
verses.english: Various costly beds, carpets and conveyance and hundreds of vessels set with diamonds and Vaidurya gems. to

verses.sanskrit: रूपयौवनदाक्षिण्यैरुपेताश्च स्वलङ्कृताः। प्रेष्याः संप्रददौ कृष्णो नानादेश्याः स्वलङ्कृताः॥१६॥
verses.english: Krishna gave them thousands of maidservants, all young, beautiful and accomplished and adorned with all ornaments and brought from various countries.

verses.sanskrit: गजान्विनीतान्भद्रांश्च सदश्वांश्च स्वलङ्कृतान्। रथांश्च दान्तान्सौवर्णैः शुभ्रैः पट्टैरलङ्कृतान्॥१७॥
verses.english: He also gave them many well-trained elephants of the country of the Madras, many excellent horses adorned with ornaments and many chariots drawn by heroes of excellent colours and large teeth.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिशश्च सुवर्णं च तेषामकृतकं तथा। वीथीकृतममेयात्मा प्राहिणोन्मधुसूदनः॥१८॥
verses.english: Madhusudan (Krishna) of immeasurable soul sent to them also in separate heaps millions of coins of pure gold.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वं प्रतिजग्राह धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। मुदा परमया युक्तो गोविन्दप्रियकाम्यया॥१९॥
verses.english: Wishing to please Govinda (Krishna), Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, being himself filled with great joy, accepted all those presents.
verses.bhavadeepa: अकृतकं जाम्बूनदम् आकरेषु धमनादिना अनुत्पादितं । वीथीकृतं धान्यराशिवत् पृथक्पृथक् मालया राशीकृतम् । राशीकृतमिति पाठे पिण्डीकृतम् । कृताकृतमिति पाठे घटितमघटितं च ॥१८॥
